candidates.name: Hugh Brinson Pipeline / Abilene Lateral

evidence.note: Energy Transfer Q2 2026 release: completed another 14-mile lateral off the Hugh Brinson Pipeline in Abilene, ready for service. Length 14 mi.

candidates.why_maybe_new: 14 mi lateral, no row of its own; parent P3885 Hugh Brinson (442 mi mainline). Q4 2025 call described a first lateral flowing to a data center campus near Abilene, so this is the second of several (two more expected mid-2026). May overlap the EIA seed Oracle Data Center Laterals; consolidate. Data center tie is from the Oracle and Crusoe campus context in earnings coverage; the release text itself says only Abilene lateral.
